scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && tsc --noEmit && bun run build:sandpiper && bun run build:standalone
scripts.build:sandpiper: mkdir -p dist && bun build --production --minify --target=bun --external canvas --external css-tree ./sandpiper_standalone.ts --outfile ./dist/sandpiper && chmod +x ./dist/sandpiper
scripts.build:standalone: mkdir -p dist/standalone && bun build --production --minify --target=bun --external canvas --external css-tree ./sandpiper_standalone.ts --outdir ./dist/standalone
scripts.preinstall: mkdir -p dist && bun copy-assets && bun run build:sandpiper && bun run build:standalone
